Messages.Author: jeff...@pacbell.net
Messages.Body:
I have Heidelberg Castle in play and two vampires, one of which has a
Cooler with 4 counters.

During my untap, can I give Vamp A blood from the Cooler, then move it
via Heidelberg, and give the other Vamp B blood also?

TIA,

Jeff

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
jeff...@pacbell.net wrote:



No. You can only move a blood to the bearer once each untap.

Equipment. Put 4 blood counters on this card. During your untap phase,
if the vampire with this equipment is ready, you may move 1 blood from
this card to this vampire. Burn this card when it has no counters.

So you mean "the vampire" and "this vampire" in the cardtext above can
be several vampires ? Ooo, interesting, do that also apply to:

Weirding Stone
Camarilla Vitae Slave
Homunculus
and other similar cards
?

I'm pretty sure that the only thing LSJ's saying here is that Cooler's

bearers it goes through. "During X, do Y" and all that. Same would

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
BobbyDoc wrote:
> So you mean "the vampire" and "this vampire" in the cardtext above can
> be several vampires ? Ooo, interesting, do that also apply to:

"This vampire" is only ever one particular vampire at any given time.
It means "the vampire with this card".

If the card moves, then "this vampire" refers to the new vampire with
the card.

> Weirding Stone
> Camarilla Vitae Slave
> Homunculus
> and other similar cards
> ?

Yes.
Indeed, CVS and Homunculus use "The vampire with this retainer".
